title.rendered: Milagrow CoinSucker Vacuum Cleaner Only For Car

content.rendered:
Milagrow CoinSucker Vacuum Cleaner The Powerful Car Vacuum Cleaner With Cord, The Lightweight (680 Grams) Handheld Vacuum Cleaner Is Perfect For Quick Car, SUV Or Truck Cleanups, Featuring A HEPA-12 Washable Filter, Fitted With A 90 Watt Motor And Cyclonic 8200 Pa Suction, It Tackles Dirt, Cigarette Ash, Food Crumbs, Chips And Pet Hair Effortlessly. The Vacuum Includes 3 Cleaning Attachments (Flat Nozzle, Hose Pipe, And A Multi-utility Brush), A Convenient Storage Bag, HEPA-12 Filter, 500 Ml Dust Collector. Powered By A 12V Cigarette Lighter Socket And A 5 Meter Long Power Cord, It Offers Easy Access To All Areas Of Your Car, Truck, Or Boat. Lightweight And Practical, This Vacuum Is A Must Have For On-the-go Cleaning Needs 24×7.

About this product

  1. Compact And Lightweight Car Vacuum- Weighing Just 680 Grams , It’s Both Portable And Easy To Use, Making It Ideal For Handling Dust, Food Spills, Ash, And More. Equipped With A HEPA-12 Filter, This Small Yet Powerful Vacuum Comes With A Fully Loaded Interior Cleaning Kit And An Ergonomic Handle For Comfortable Handling.
  2. Powerful And Efficient- Whether You’re Dealing With Sand From The Beach, Dust On The Floor Mats Or Pet Hair, This Handheld Vacuum Cleaner Is Built For Tough, Out-of-reach Messes. Its Portable Design Makes It A Reliable Solution For Everyday Cleaning Needs For Your Vehicle.
  3. Strong Suction Performance- Featuring A 120 W Motor And Mammoth 8200 Pa Suction Power, This Vacuum Effectively Removes Dirt, Debris, Pet Hair And Stubborn Crumbs. The High-performance Washable HEPA-12 Filter Ensures Optimal Dust Filtration.
  4. Complete Car Cleaning Kit- This Handy Vacuum Includes 3 Versatile Attachments ( A Flexible Hose Pipe, A Flat Nozzle, And A Nozzle Brush), An Extra HEPA-12 Filter And A Storage Bag.This Car Cleaning Kit With The Storage Bag Keeps You Worry Free From Losing Your Attachment.
  5. Convenient And Corded- Say Goodbye To Charging Frustrations. This Vacuum Plugs Directly Into The 12V Auxiliary Outlet Of Your Car. The 16-foot Cord Provides Plenty Of Reach To Clean The Back Seat, Trunk, Or Even Boats With A 12V Cigarette Lighter Port. Clean Efficiently Without Worrying About Battery Life.
